config.description: webjs only: explicitly disable the browser sandbox for containers that require it. The sandbox is enabled by default.

config.description: webjs only: browser executable. Chrome and Edge are auto-detected; set this to use a specific browser. Chrome/Edge is required for sending videos and GIFs.

config.description: webjs only: persistent browser profile directory (default: <working directory>/whatsapp-sessions)

config.description: Phone number pairing: when set (international, symbol-free format, e.g. 4915112345678), an 8-character pairing code is logged to stderr on startup instead of relying on the QR code

config.label: Path to an ffmpeg binary (only needed to override the ffmpeg installed automatically via the ffmpeg-static npm package)
config.description: Path to an ffmpeg binary (only needed to override the ffmpeg installed automatically via the ffmpeg-static npm package)

config.label: webjs only: pin the WhatsApp Web version if a WhatsApp-side update breaks the client
config.description: webjs only: pin the WhatsApp Web version if a WhatsApp-side update breaks the client.

config.description: Bind address for the HTTP endpoint (do not expose publicly; the endpoint controls your personal WhatsApp account)
